review:
Where Hacksaw's DuelReels started: the Outlaw faces the Sheriff on every expanded VS reel, with multipliers from 2x to 200x. The survivor's value covers the whole wild reel, and several reels in one win add together.

The Outlaw Feature adds another route, where an Outlaw symbol expands into a full reel on its own. It's the blueprint for loads of duel games since. 15,000x max. Sources disagree on its RTP, so we don't list one.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
